Name: External Identifier ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the external identifier record. Only available when updating existing records.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person to whom this external identifier belongs.

Name: Sequence
Description: The sequence of the external identifier.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person to whom this external identifier belongs.

Name: Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment to which this external identifier relates.

Name: Assignment Number
Description: The assignment number to which the external identifier belongs.

Name: Comments
Description: Comments for the external identifier.

Name: External Identifier Number
Description: The external identifier number.

Name: External Identifier Type
Description: The type of external identifier, such as Third-Party Payroll ID.

Name: From Date and Time
Description: The date and time from when the external identifier is valid.

Name: To Date and Time
Description: The date and time until when the external identifier is valid.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
